name: upgrade-owned-scaffold-scope
body: The refresh set is exactly the kalide-owned scaffold content scoped to the project's form: (a) a deck-root `AGENTS.md` (agent-authoring) and, for a no-arg seed deck only, the `kalide init` seed starter content (cli-init-minimal-seed: the seed `templates/library.yaml`, the `hello` slide template `templates/slides/hello/*`, the seed default theme `templates/themes/default/theme.css`, and `slides/1-hello.md`); (b) a library-root `AGENTS.md` (library-agent-guide) and, only when it is the seeded default, `themes/default/theme.css` (init-library). Each member is written only while it is present and byte-identical to a known released kalide version, except the `AGENTS.md` guides, which are also written when absent; a seed starter file that is absent — because the author deleted it after init — is never re-created. A no-arg seed deck is exactly a deck whose `kalide.yaml` has no non-empty `templates:` key and whose local `templates/` directory exists (template.ResolveLibraryRoot's local branch); a non-empty `templates:` key makes it an external-library deck even when a local `templates/` is also present. Only a no-arg seed deck can own the seed tree; the seed-owned paths are `templates/library.yaml`, `templates/slides/hello/*`, `templates/themes/default/theme.css` and `slides/1-hello.md`. The set never includes author slides/sections/templates/themes/media, never an external-library deck's absent or leftover local `templates/`, and never a library's templates. `kalide.yaml` is the author-edited deck config and is not a whole-file refresh member. A file outside this scoped set is never written, whatever its contents.
